content: {"like":["Enjoys classic sci‑fi with visionary directors like George Pal and memorable scores such as Russell Garcia’s.", "Values high‑quality audio that captures jazz cues and live performances in period dramas.", "Appreciates faithful restoration of original music in older films, e.g., Olive Films’ work on A New Leaf.", "Prefers well‑executed survival narratives, especially those with strong character focus like The Flight of the Phoenix.", "Enjoys detective series with strong thematic elements, such as technology themes in Perry Mason Season 3."],"dislike":["Dislikes simplistic good‑vs‑evil plots that feel clunky, as in the Morlok storyline of Time Machine.", "Finds inconsistent sound quality frustrating, especially when it varies across episodes or releases.", "Objects to missing original aspect ratios, preferring theatrical widescreen over pan‑and‑scan versions.", "Dislikes the absence of alternate director cuts that offer extended content or different endings.", "Rejects releases lacking English dubbed soundtracks for foreign titles, such as Spirits Of The Dead 1968."]}
